name: Statistical / quantitative mispricing models (polls, ratings, base rates, nowcasts, recalibration)
one_line: Trade the gap between public statistical models (FluSight, CDC counts, Cleveland Fed nowcast, ratings, domain/horizon recalibration slopes) and the Polymarket price with proper-betting sizing and resting orders; gaps are documented, tradable size is small, no Polymarket PnL published.
maturity: Emerging; recalibration and disease-baseline gaps documented in papers (no net-of-cost test), macro centres at Kalshi's price, base-rate models untested, no Polymarket PnL for any variant
requires_ai: no; optional rules-to-series mapping; LLM nowcasts only match consensus
edge: Political underconfidence (slope 1.45), ignored public ensembles in thin niches, sizing discipline
capital: $1k-$10k; politics deploys $10k, macro/disease rungs hold $24-$2.7k of depth
build_time: 2-3 weeks on an LP stack; 6-8 weeks from scratch
opportunity_size: Fed $15.5M vol but Kalshi-parity; CPI/jobs ladders $17-44k vol; measles $8M vol, $26k liq; politics $60-460k liq per market
expected_results: No Polymarket PnL; Kalshi live +80% on $200 (affiliated); replay +15.9% on 44 decisions; guess $0-400/month at $10k
competition: Fed/CPI arbitraged vs Kalshi; niches uncontested but tiny
flag: none; grey data licence if incorporated; health markets reputational
validate: Apply published slopes to 2026 resolved politics markets, clustered Brier + paper PnL over >=350 markets; nowcast vs mid on 12 releases
top_risk: Edge indistinguishable from noise for a year; clustered election losses
solo_fit_reason: Free data, no latency race and a reusable sizing layer make it cheap to test, but the deep markets are efficient, the mispriced ones hold tens of dollars per rung, and a 2 pp political tilt cannot be told from luck within a year at $10k.
speed_class: speed-insensitive: hours-to-weeks edges; only the release second is fast
results_10k: -$150 to +$400/month (guess); 12-month average p10 -$360 even at 2 pp edge
min_capital: ~$2k so ten $150-200 positions survive a cluster loss
capacity_ceiling: ~$50-100k politics tilt; $1-5k/season flu; zero on Fed/CPI centres
services: CDC FluSight hub + CDC measles counter
changes_made: Written 2026-09-28 with live Gamma, CLOB and Kalshi checks: Fed October and September CPI ladders priced within 1-3 pp of Kalshi; non-Fed macro rungs hold $0-$216 within 2c of mid.
Cleveland Fed nowcast (0.50% CPI, 0.20% core) and CDC measles count (3,659) compared with the live ladders as worked examples, no mispricing claimed.
Maturity kept at Emerging per sub-variant; category 'Directional trading' kept; 2024 election evidence cited against poll-model edge; proper-betting sizing layer included as the reusable module.
Own 12-month simulation used for the $1k/$5k/$10k rows, labelled guess/derived.

Cite-check 2026-09-28 16:05-16:20 UTC (27 sources re-fetched, live Gamma/CLOB/Kalshi queries re-run, Monte Carlo and Elo arithmetic recomputed): Fortune/NBER perfect-record period corrected from 'through June 2024' to '2022 through June 2025'; the calibration paper's cost treatment corrected (it cites Kalshi's ~1.2-1.3c mean fee to rule fees out, never tests the tilt net of costs); the taker-delay claim narrowed to crypto and finance up/down markets with an own CLOB-record check on Fed and core-CPI markets; Elo match-win range corrected 0.87-0.93 -> 0.86-0.92; LiveMacroEval betting results restated per agency; Convexly 40%-unresolved-fills caveat added; 2024-data labels on the two election papers; base-rate / reference-class and hurricane-market coverage added (both untested); an unsourced 'public criticism' claim replaced with Asterisk's no-demand finding; a file-21 sentence on LLM agents removed; ~60 words of duplicated numbers cut.
open_doubts: No paper tests the political recalibration tilt after spread, fee and settlement discount; half of the slope variation is estimation noise; the 2024-election papers predate fees.
Flu ladders exist only in season (none live on 2026-09-28); the FluSight replay must use prices-history, not archived books.
Kalshi results (NBER, proper-betting live run) may not transfer to Polymarket's thinner macro books; the live-run paper has a Kalshi co-author and 26 days of data.

Base-rate / reference-class and hurricane-outlook models have no Polymarket evidence at all; the measles pace example projects ~5,000 cases at constant pace against a 0.885 price, which is an illustration, not a tested edge.
Chess ratings example is a derived illustration with a guessed draw rate, not evidence of edge.
